items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I think Maria Schneider’s last CD was a finger point at all of the digital lords out there.

ctx.x: I wanted to follow-up on something you just touched on about ownership. And you’ve done a lot of work in the field of intellectual property. Does the field and the guidelines and the way things work keep getting more complicated?

Extremely complicated. Yes. One of the whole digital rights movement and the very quick changeover to the distribution model of music now is very complicated. There’s just been a big reorganization of the mechanical rights organizations forming a consortium with the government’s permission. Things are changing very very quickly because you no longer have the physical control of the product. Record companies have no control. Individuals have no control. So it’s getting more and more difficult to identify what is…
You said, oh she finger pointed at them. Is that what you said?
